profile.headline: Sr. Software Engineer at Uber
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer at Stripe, helping to increase the GDP of the internet! Currently working on systems that allow businesses to create, manage, and distribute virtual and physical cards at scale.

I am passionate about all things tech, and enjoy using creativity to build innovative, user-focused products for the future. I value simplicity and readability in code, achieving complexity through modularity, and thrive in collaborative environments.

Prior to Stripe I worked at Blue Origin, helping to build the road to space. In my past life, I worked as a Program Manager & Industrial Engineer for Boeing on numerous mission critical projects around the world.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a suite of microservices to handle supply chain logistics and track inventory of millions of parts. Implemented REST and GraphQL APIs in Java and Node.js.
• Led an enterprise-wide AWS migration initiative to increase system scalability and reliability by being the first team to fully transition Kubernetes services to the cloud. Provided guidance to other teams on their AWS migration.
• Enhanced testing reliability by replacing Wiremock stubs with integration tests using Cucumber, championing behavior-driven development (BDD) principles.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: • Implemented automation tools, Node.js backend services, and MySQL databases for Boeing to enhance operational efficiency with its suppliers.

positions.title: Industrial Engineer
positions.description: • Led multiple mission-critical initiatives, managing end-to-end execution and reporting to senior executives to achieve millions of dollars in cost savings and quality improvements.
